name: code-video
description: Research a topic (company, service, website, product) and render a short promo video as an MP4, drawn entirely in code. Pick a look (hand-drawn with 8-bit minis, motion graphics, sand art, arcade, terminal, thermal receipt, transit map, blueprint, and more) and a story format (standard, versus, session, receipt, route map, spec sheet, lyric music video, beat-synced footage), then research → storyboard approval → build, QA against the credited original, and render, with code-generated music.
